description: This file defines function prototypes related to merging operations in a version control system, including attempting a merge command and performing a fast-forward checkout.

methods.name: try_merge_command
methods.description: Attempts to execute a merge command with a specified strategy and options within a repository context.

methods.name: checkout_fast_forward
methods.description: Performs a fast-forward checkout if possible, updating the repository from one object ID to another.
